description: Use this tool whenever a user asks whether their Traditional IRA contribution is tax-deductible, how much they can contribute directly to a Roth IRA under IRC Sec. 408A, how workplace 401(k) coverage or spouse-only coverage affects 2025-2027 MAGI phase-out bands (including IRC Sec. 219(g)(4) MFS lived-apart rules and IRS Pub. 590-A $10 rounding / $200 floor), or whether they should execute a Form 8606 Backdoor Roth.

agi.description: Adjusted Gross Income (AGI) in USD before Traditional IRA deduction.

earnedIncome.description: Taxable W-2 / self-employment compensation in USD (defaults to AGI; caps contribution under IRC Sec. 219(b)(1)(B)).

mfsLivedTogether.description: For married_separate only: false if spouses lived apart at ALL times during the tax year (IRC Sec. 219(g)(4)).

over50.description: True if taxpayer is age 50 or older at year-end (unlocks $1,100 IRA catch-up in 2026).

studentLoanInterest.description: Student loan interest deduction add-back for IRA MAGI in USD.

workplaceCoverage.description: 'yes' if taxpayer is an active participant in a workplace retirement plan (W-2 Box 13), 'spouse' if ONLY spouse is covered, or 'no' if neither is covered.

name: check_ira_deductibility_and_roth_limits
title: Check 2025-2027 Traditional IRA Tax Deductibility (IRC Sec. 219(g)), Direct Roth Limit & Backdoor Roth Eligibility
